title: R7-01: P0 core/integration: P14 runner-profile prefill (in-memory, scrubbed) + safety update, runtime fallback to task alternatives after provider_error/site_unreachable_in_h, P13 verification fixes for Njuko form_individual-form and hotel-bb room list, Njuko white-label scrub, stale docs (AGENTS.md Accor/personal-data/Milan), owner decision record, R7 queue
spec:
Context: round 6 scored 38/100, 0/5 live. Only 1 of 15 agents verified READY. Milan Njuko `form_individual-form` and Den Haag IHG `select-enhance-stay` were reached on screen but ended P13 'à vérifier'. Milan SBB failed, then the Vueling alternative died with 'Browser startup unavailable'. The owner now approves personal-data prefill, so runs can advance further. No open PRs exist (old PR #1 'T01' is not open), so nothing needs taking over.
1) Implement P14 exactly as pinned below in models/app/providers/hclient/scrub. Add CONTRACTS.md section 'P14 Runner profile prefill (round 7)'. Add the profile endpoint with in-memory storage, `profile_status` in Mission, and clear-on-delete/mission-end. The Mission JSON, events and logs must never contain the values. Extend the privacy tests with sentinel values and grep the full API/event/log output.
2) Runtime alternatives: when the primary task ends provider_error (incl. internal site_unreachable_in_h / 'Browser startup unavailable'), no_site_coverage at runtime, or blocked before any frame, run `task['alternatives']` sequentially. Emit one friendly 'Essai d’un autre site' status, cap total wall time at 15 min per agent, and never retry after a safety stop (captcha/consent/login/terms) or a READY. 'Browser startup unavailable' gets one delayed retry (20 s) of the same task first.
3) Verification: reproduce offline with synthetic observations the R6 failures: Njuko `form_individual-form` (registration ended 'verification unavailable'), hotel-bb room/rate list ('result could not be verified') and IHG Den Haag select-enhance-stay. Fix the verification gates so a genuine checkpoint frame plus a correct city/dates/party verifies READY. Do not weaken mandatory checks and log gate names only.
4) scrub.py: accept Njuko white-label hosts (e.g. in.motionevents-registrations.com) for the 13-digit public event id.
5) Docs: record the round-7/8 owner decision verbatim in docs/feedback/owner.md (newest first): no site excluded for ToS, big-site adapters, advance as far as possible, minimize client actions, owner-approved prefill with the privacy rules, unchanged hard guardrails. Update AGENTS.md/PLAN.md/README: remove stale 'Accor denied', 'never enter personal data' (replace with P14 rules) and any Milan-only wording, and point the queue at R7. Write docs/tickets/R7-0x.md + index.json from this plan. Replace test_r6_scope_contract.py with test_r7_scope_contract.py (exact disjoint R7 file sets).
6) After siblings merge, run the integrated visible acceptance: one mission at a time, three agents parallel, at least Milan + Berlin + one other, using the fake profile. Record it in docs/evidence/h-client.md and HANDOFF.md.
P14 (pinned this round, owner-approved personal-data prefill; R7-01 implements core, siblings code against it and import lazily/fail closed): (1) Runner profile = {full_name, given_name, family_name, email, phone, birth_date (ISO), gender, nationality (ISO-3166 alpha-2), address_line, postal_code, city, country}; all optional strings. It lives ONLY in process memory on the mission (never in Mission JSON responses, events, logs, evidence, replay fixtures or disk); the API exposes only `profile_status: {complete: bool, fields: [field names present]}`. (2) `POST /api/missions/{id}/profile` with that object (pydantic, length-capped, email/phone/date validated) returns the Mission (profile_status only). DELETE clears it. Allowed in guiding/ready states only. (3) At confirm, the LiveRunner passes the profile to builders as `trip['runner_profile']` (dict, may be absent). Builders MUST NOT copy values into `instructions` text; they set `task['prefill_fields']=[field names the site form needs]` and `task['prefill_scope']` (short description e.g. 'participant form', 'guest details', 'passenger details'). hclient appends, only in the prompt sent to H, a block 'Runner profile (type only into the {prefill_scope} fields; never submit a final form)' containing exactly the prefill_fields values, and scrubs every profile value (and case-folded variants) from steps, answers, summaries, handoff URLs and logs before anything leaves hclient. (4) Guardrails: typing profile values into participant/guest/passenger fields is ALLOWED when prefill_fields is non-empty; pressing an intermediate 'Continue/Next' that only moves to the next form page is allowed; still NEVER pay, create an account/log in, accept terms/medical/consent checkboxes, solve captchas, or press a final submit/confirm/book/pay button. `_payment_claim` keeps rejecting payment/booking/form_submitted(final)/account_created/terms_accepted; `personal_data_entered=true` is accepted only when the task had prefill_fields. (5) Checkpoint semantics: a task may carry `checkpoint['prefill_patterns']` (pages where fields are typed, do NOT force_answer there) in addition to url_patterns (final pre-payment stop) and beyond_patterns. Without a profile, behaviour is exactly as today (stop at first personal-data page untouched). (6) StepResult gains optional `prefilled: bool` and `stop_label` (short friendly FR/EN-neutral string such as 'payment page reached'); never contains values.
Python 3.12: `uv sync --frozen && uv run ruff check . && uv run pytest -q` green. Touch ONLY the listed files (otherwise stop and request a scope amendment from R7-01). Before each live smoke check H quota (GET /api/v2/sessions/quota, available>=1), use at most one H session at a time, record dated scrubbed evidence (public host/path, status, reason_code, steps, stop page) with NO real personal data: use the fake identity 'Test Runner', test.runner@example.com, +33 6 00 00 00 00, 1990-01-01, F/M, FR, '1 rue de Test, 75001 Paris'. H/site frames are in_session_only: never commit screenshots of them. Write docs/handoff/<id>.md with changes, pasted check output, evidence, blockers.
acceptance: uv run ruff check . && uv run pytest -q green; focused: uv run pytest -q tests/test_hclient.py tests/test_api_profile.py tests/test_api_privacy.py tests/test_r7_scope_contract.py tests/test_journey_e2e.py. Behavioral: (a) sentinel profile values never appear in any Mission JSON, event, StepResult, log record or handoff URL; profile_status shows only field names. (b) An H prompt contains the values only when prefill_fields is non-empty and only those fields. (c) personal_data_entered=true is accepted with prefill_fields and rejected without them; payment/account/terms/final-submit claims are always rejected. (d) A primary provider_error leads to the next alternative running, with one friendly status line. A captcha/consent stop does not retry. 'Browser startup unavailable' is retried once. (e) Synthetic Njuko form_individual-form, hotel-bb room list and IHG Den Haag observations verify READY; wrong dates or a missing frame stay blocked. (f) A white-label Njuko URL scrubs to itself. (g) AGENTS.md contains no 'Accor denied'/Milan-only/'never enter personal data' text; owner.md has the R7 decision. Live: >=1 quota-gated integrated mission with fake profile recorded honestly.

title: R7-04: P1 guide: fewest questions (auto-defaults, one-click confirm), origin correction never re-searches races (A04), nonexistent race said honestly (A05), Valencia/major races found (A03), dodge without failing re-search (A02), dedupe (A08/A09), runner-profile prompt once before confirm, clean synthetic labels, adversarial suite incl. R6 failures
spec:
Round-6 adversarial failures to fix, each with a regression row:
- A04: Milan marathon, then 'je pars de Lyon', then 'non de Genève' replaced the race with the Geneva marathon and kept origin Lyon. A city given after an origin question, or in a correction ('non de X', 'plutôt depuis X', 'from X instead'), updates origin_city only. Never pick a default distance shorter than the requested type (a marathon never defaults to 5 km).
- A05: 'marathon d’Atlantis 2027' was answered with Abalone Nantes as 'correspondant à ta recherche'. Say the named race was not found, then offer clearly labelled alternatives ('je ne trouve pas … voici des marathons proches de ta demande').
- A03: 'marathon de Valencia' was not found. Named major races resolve deterministically: Valencia, Berlin, Paris, London, Rome, Barcelona, Madrid, Amsterdam, Lisbon, Porto, Milan, Frankfurt, Seville. A targeted standard-depth query should prefer the organizer domain.
- A02: 'je sais pas' must not trigger a new search. Propose the current best default.
- A08/A09: dedupe candidates by normalized name+date+city, and resolve conflicting dates to the official one or label them 'à confirmer'.
- A12: country names localized ('Autriche').
Owner goal 'minimize client actions': once a race is chosen, apply the origin (Paris unless given), nights (2) and budget defaults automatically. Reach `ready` with a single summary message ('Je pars sur … modifier ?' chips) instead of one question per field. Target: a vague request reaches a ready plan in <=2 user clicks. The final-question copy must match the state: no 'Ça te va comme point de départ ?' when everything is set.
Profile: when the plan is ready and mission profile_status.complete is false (state hint may be absent: getattr/fail closed), add one assistant line inviting the user to fill the runner profile card once so agents can prefill forms, plus a chip 'Continuer sans profil'. Never parse, echo or store PII typed in chat: if typed, reply that the secure profile card should be used and drop the values.
fake.py: replay/demo chip names without the '[Synthétique / Synthetic]' prefix (synthetic status stays explicit via existing fields/labels the UI shows). Keep >=150 adversarial conversations green (FR/EN, injection, typos, impossible requests, early confirm -> never launch without explicit confirm of the current ready plan).

title: R7-05: P0 design polish to >=9/10 (Strava-grade): secure runner-profile card (once, privacy note, fake-safe), three live agent cards that never look broken at launch, honest CTA per covered agents, 'advanced as far as possible' end states (prefilled/at payment), copy/placeholder fixes, mobile
spec:
Round-6 design score was 8/10. Weaknesses to fix:
(1) Right after launch, 1-2 of the 3 cards show an empty 'Aucun site ouvert' panel. Instead show an energetic 'connexion au site…' skeleton/shimmer with real elapsed time until the first frame. If coverage is missing, show it on the plan card BEFORE confirmation, and make the CTA honest ('Lancer les 2 agents disponibles' / 'Launch 3 agents').
(2) The pre-launch coverage copy must not contradict the CTA.
(3) Final-question copy and composer placeholder follow the stage (plan editing: 'Modifier le plan… (ex. départ de Lyon, 3 nuits)').
(4) Replay chips must not show '[Synthétique / Synthetic]'. Show a small 'Synthetic' badge from mission mode instead.
(5) Keep the 'Bilan' summary above the fold on 1440x900.
New, P14 profile card: a beautiful, compact 'Profil coureur' card in the plan stage with name, email, phone, birth date, gender, nationality and optional address. Show a clear privacy note (kept in memory for this mission only, typed by the agents into forms, never stored), plus 'Remplir avec un profil de test' (fills the fake 'Test Runner' identity) and 'Continuer sans profil'. Submit POSTs /api/missions/{id}/profile and shows only the profile_status field names/check marks, never re-rendering the values from the server. Fail gracefully (hide the card) if the endpoint returns 404/501. Never log values to the console, and never put them in the URL or localStorage.
End states: show the new StepResult `prefilled`/`stop_label` as a premium success state ('Formulaire pré-rempli · prêt à payer') with the 'Continuer sur <site>' handoff. The live stage stays agents-only: genuine frames, one friendly status line, no raw task/JSON/logs. 'Essai d’un autre site' fallback animation.
Overall: Strava-inspired bold typography, orange energy, motion (reduced-motion respected), empty/loading/error states, responsive 390px.
